decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY captures the Hero V impact but omits the explicitly requested right-arm termination from its construction criteria.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The larger objective should remain in view: if the letters EILLVÉ disappeared, the opening V would still need to feel unmistakably like veillvé. That is the degree of distinction I hope we can achieve, and I believe the rest of the wordmark will develop naturally once the V is resolved.

Starting with the V was exactly the right move. I’d like that exploration to continue before we return to the complete wordmark because I believe the brand’s identity will be established in this form first.

The beauty must come from proportion, geometry, and construction rather than applied details. Every choice should feel structural, not stylistic. This is especially important for the V’s right arm, where much more can be explored. Instead of reading as simply another letter stroke, it should function as an integral part of the construction. Please investigate its proportion, width, length, and termination so that it feels deliberate without becoming decorative.

Let’s also keep all current work entirely in black and white. Champagne metallic treatment remains part of the long-term vision, but color should not affect these decisions yet. Geometry needs to be solved first; the material should enhance the design rather than define it.

value_updates.construction_basis: Distinctiveness and beauty must come from structural proportion, geometry, and construction rather than applied decoration.
value_updates.right_arm_role: An integral, deliberate part of the V construction whose proportion, width, length, and termination establish distinction without decoration.
value_updates.development_sequence: Resolve the Hero V geometry entirely in black and white before applying champagne metallic treatment.

decisions.reason: The necessary black-and-white geometry-first sequence is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The same-message MODIFY and DEFER already capture that champagne treatment remains required but must follow resolution of the geometry.
The letterforms were already deferred until the V system is resolved, and this source only reiterates that sequencing without changing their required form.
The complete composition was already deferred, and the source does not change its composition, kerning, or hierarchy requirements.
The geometry-first instruction governs the current V-system development sequence and does not necessarily alter the existing broader brand-expression attributes.
The source reinforces the opening V's importance but does not change the wordmark-led identity or the prohibition on a separate icon or monogram.
